sdk.title: SDK quick start
sdk.description: Use the PAT created above to submit and watch experiments with the Python SDK; every experiment action available on the web can be done with the SDK. The server does not offer the package for download yet, so install it from the repository. Keep the token in an environment variable, not in code.
sdk.scopes: A read PAT can query, resolve configurations and download; submitting and rerunning need an experiment PAT. A client wait timing out does not cancel the run on the server.
sdk.skill: To let an Agent act for you, load the skill {{path}} from the repository and provide the address and token through the environment variables MAESTRO_URL and MAESTRO_TOKEN_FILE.

pat.title: Personal access tokens (PAT)
pat.description: For the SDK and scripts. read can only read; experiment can also submit and cancel your own runs. A PAT never has admin rights. The run limit counts accepted runs.
pat.name: Name
pat.runLimitHint_one: This token can submit at most {{count}} run
pat.runLimitHint_other: This token can submit at most {{count}} runs
pat.revokeConfirm: Revoke access token "{{name}}"? Scripts using it stop working immediately.
pat.deleteConfirmActive: Delete access token "{{name}}"? It stops working immediately and is removed from the list (an admin can restore the record from the recycle bin).
pat.deleteConfirm: Delete access token "{{name}}"? It is removed from the list (an admin can restore the record from the recycle bin).
